metadata.name: GoodTrip [Fixed]
metadata.description:
Teleport to cleared rooms directly from the minimap — now fixed, polished, and highly configurable.
This is a maintained version of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1630477831]GoodTrip[/url]. You only need to enable GoodTrip [Fixed]; the original mod is not required.
HOW TO USE
- Mouse: hold the map button (TAB by default), then click a room on the minimap. - Keyboard/controller: hold the map button and use the shooting directions to select a room on the teleport map. - Drag the teleport map anywhere you like, or pin it to click rooms without holding TAB. - Both your current room and destination normally need to be cleared, and you cannot teleport during combat.
KEY FIXES
- Fixed Tainted Forgotten throwing his bone when navigating with TAB + ↑↓←→. - Fixed mouse teleportation and map orientation in the Downpour II mirror world. - HUD offset is detected automatically from options.ini. - Fixed compatibility with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1978904635]Minimap API[/url] and Repentance+. - Prevented accidental tear firing when clicking the teleport map. - The teleport map remembers its position between runs.
FEATURES
Configure these features with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]Mod Config Menu[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2494192799]Mod配置菜单（中文版）[/url]:
- Bookmark rooms with TAB + 1, TAB + 2, etc.; use the same shortcut again to teleport back (MCM: AllowBookmarking). - Return to the previously visited room with TAB + Z; press it again to return (MCM: LastRoomShortcut). - Restart quickly with TAB + R (MCM: FastRestartEnable). - Controller users can assign alternate buttons for the Z and R shortcuts. - While a room is uncleared the teleport map stays on screen, faint and inert, instead of disappearing: no trip is possible mid-fight, but the window no longer looks like the mod broke. Turn it off for the old behaviour (MCM: DimMapInCombat, on by default; DimMapAlpha sets how faint). - Show special-room icons on rooms you have already visited: the mirror room and white fireplace in Downpour II, minecart and buttons in Mines II, and tinted skull in Depths II (MCM: ShowSpecialIcons). - Teleport into an uncleared room when it has a cleared neighbor (MCM: AllowNeighborRoom). - Require a path of cleared rooms between you and the target, so an isolated island is no free ride (MCM: FairTripPath). Thanks @Kattack! - Optionally ignore Curse of the Lost (MCM: FollowCurseOfLost). - Move quickly to a neighboring room with TAB + WASD (MCM: QuicklyOneRoomMove, off by default). - Move the teleport-map cursor faster with TAB + ↑↓←→ (MCM: FasterCursorMove, off by default). - Remove the black transition animation for faster teleportation (MCM: FastTransition, off by default). - Integrate with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3071704639]Dangerous room! Caution[/url] to color dangerous rooms. - Enable Fair Trip rules, which add time based on movement speed and the length of the cleared route (MCM: FairTripTime, off by default). Thanks @iamthestoat and @Porp! - Bind a custom keyboard/controller button for the teleport map, useful for avoiding EID's TAB shortcut (MCM: OverlayKey / OverlayKeyController). Thanks @Porp! - Scale the teleport map from 0.5x to 2.5x (MCM: MinimapScale). - Move the cursor with the movement keys instead of the shoot keys, so aiming doesn't fire (MCM: SwapAnalogSticks, off by default). Thanks @Porp! - Keep aiming while you walk, instead of the cursor pausing until you let go of the movement keys (MCM: IgnoreMovementKeys, off by default). - Put the cursor on the game's own corner map and leave this mod's window hidden — needs [url=https://repentogon.com/]REPENTOGON[/url] to draw above the map, and the switch is only offered when it is installed (MCM: CursorOnGameMap, off by default). - Full Chinese config menu support, if you are using [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2494192799]Mod配置菜单（中文版）[/url].
FAQ
No Mod Config Menu? Open gtconfig.lua in the mod folder and uncomment the settings you want. Strongest first: gtconfig.lua beats your saved config, which beats the defaults in main.lua — so editing main.lua no longer does anything, and a line in gtconfig.lua sticks on every launch even if the menu changes it while you play. Steam replaces the file when the mod updates, so keep a copy of your edits.
Accidentally dragged the teleport map into the trash? Restore it from MCM, or enter this command in the in-game console: lua gt:get_config().KeyboardMapEnable=true gt.save_config()
如果你装的是[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2494192799]Mod配置菜单（中文版）[/url]，本 mod 的设置界面就是中文的，选项名、说明、分页全都翻译好了。原版的 Mod Config Menu 画文字是一个字节一个字节画的，中文塞进去只会变成乱码。因此我无法在原版MCM里写中文，中文界面只在这个中文版菜单下才有。
Original [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1630477831]GoodTrip[/url] by @tarako Co-authored with @Porp GitHub: https://github.com/archibate/isaacmods
